title: Default Settings - Set the default settings for your game

posts.author: Jollo
posts.body:
Default Settings 1.0
By Jollo
​
Introduction
With this plugin it is possible to set the default settings for your game.
RPG Maker MZ unfortunately does not offer any options for this and the default volume of the music and sound effects can really tickle your eardrums. Protect the future players of your game by turning down the volume for the first start of the game!
Once the player starts the game the settings can be changed as normal. And as soon as a savegame is created, this plugin will no longer interfere with the settings.
Have fun with it and hope it helps someone else out there.
Features
Set the default settings for your project.
Free addition
: With the "Volume steps" option, you can specify the steps in which the sound settings are changed. By default, it is always 20%.
How to Use
Activate the plugin in the editor. There you can change the values for the different audio-options.
Download
https://jolloex.itch.io/default-settings-plugin-for-rpg-maker-mz
Terms and Credits
This plugin is free to use for commercial and non-commercial RPG Maker Games.
